result.name: react_get_renders
result.title: Render report
result.description: Timing fields are bundle-dependent; counts describe the observed run, not a production estimate. Report bounded component render counts, observed React input changes, stable mount identity, runtime timing, and source. Start a measurement with react_clear_renders, drive one interaction, then read this. The default summary view keeps compact per-component evidence; view:"full" adds input values and diffs, behavior assessment, detailed source provenance and the legacy unnecessary/forget fields. Arguments: nameFilter: minimum characters 1, maximum characters 160; excludeNames: maximum items 50; excludeNames[]: minimum characters 1, maximum characters 160; minUpdates: minimum 0; cursor: minimum characters 1, maximum characters 100; sort: one of "renders", "updates", "unnecessary", "referenceOnly", "unstable", "selfTime"; limit: minimum 1, maximum 200; view: one of "summary", "full".

component.description: Only components whose name contains this string.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive whole-name glob: * matches any text and ? matches one character. Applied before limit.

excludeNames.description: Case-insensitive whole-name globs to exclude before limit.

minUpdates.description: Minimum observed update count, applied before limit.

includeCursor.description: Retain a frozen cursor for remaining rows. Set false for polling or one-shot reads: no snapshot is retained, the summary still covers the selected records, and omitted rows have no cursor.

cursor.description: Continue a frozen report using nextCursor. Pass only cursor and optional limit; counts, filters, ordering, and source coverage remain frozen. Cursors expire after five minutes or after three newer paginated reports, and clear/profile start invalidates them.

appOnly.description: Show only records with app source evidence. Unknown ownership is excluded instead of being attributed to the app; an exact app hook callsite keeps a framework-wrapped record visible.

view.description: summary (default) returns bounded decision fields; full returns every component field, including legacy aliases.

next.command: pnpm exec genie-react tools react_get_renders --output-schema --session measure
